text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1. Carry over the twelve rules that work today, unchanged.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2. Add at least six of the eight missing rules (decision D8):

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: unique document numbers, dashes in every file, the "not for

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: fabrication" label on media, BOM numbering against the exploded

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: view, figure and table captions, and a safety note where hazard

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: words appear. The safety-note rule raises a flag for a person;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: it never replaces the human review.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3. For each rule, keep one seeded-fault test repository that must

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: fail, and the passing fixture that must pass.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fits: reads only the reader's record (joint 1); hands CI an exit

svg.text: still pass; a full run stays under 2 s.
